_doc: Kinds of crime (T-0091, docs/design/crime-and-police.md). severity 1-8 sets police priority and punishment. An interaction commits one with "crime": "<id>"; each crime committed is saved as an incident. Only shoplifting has an interaction so far. witness (T-0092): people see a crime within day_range cells (night_range from night_from to night_until o'clock) on the same floor, awake, with nothing that blocks sight in between; each remembers it (saw_crime, memory_valence, memory_salience). police (T-0093): each witness reports with chance report_base + report_per_severity x severity (max 0.95), x friend_report_factor if their friendship with the perpetrator is >= friend_at; reported crimes count towards the wanted level for heat_hours game hours: level = ceil(sum of severities / severity_per_level), max 5. temptation (T-0097): free will offers crime interactions to residents with honesty <= honesty_below or less than broke_below cents in all, unless they are wanted or committed a crime in the last cooldown_hours; a crime that takes cash scores steal_bonus more; each person who could see it takes risk_per_witness off (times 1 - bravery/200), each police officer risk_per_officer more. steals_cash (T-0096): the crime takes that share of a person target's cash, at most max cents, unless they notice; with account bank (burglary, T-0098) it takes that share of the savings of the home's richest resident. Walking onto a lot you may not enter (someone else's home, a shop while it's closed) is trespassing, unless you work there or are an officer on a call. T-0094: an on-duty police officer goes after a wanted person and arrests them within arrest_range cells; the fine is fine_per_severity cents per severity point of the crimes reported. T-0095: officers on a call run at most officer_run_speed cells a minute (a running player does 9, walking 4.5), so running away works; an officer who loses sight of the suspect searches within search_radius cells of where they last saw them for search_minutes, then gives up; after that the crimes count towards the wanted level for only lost_heat_hours more.
